meta.title: eRFX RFQ project: recreate it after the close
gaps: Verify that every recreated product is identical to the original product by identity or product name.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that every recreated product is identical to the original product by identity or product name.

steps.note: Open the prepared existing eRFX RFQ project as the buyer.
Open the project action and choose Recreate Order.
Assert the recreate-order dialog offers the Create Order confirmation.
Confirm creation of the recreated order using the default settings.
Assert that Procol reports the recreate operation succeeded.
Assert that the newly recreated event opens on its create screen.
Assert that the recreated event retains the RFQ-only stage configuration.
Assert that the recreated event carries forward the prepared event's single line item.
